description: User acceptance test for Anascummis software creation. Existing OnlineSlop is reference material, never evidence that this model created it.

requirements.description: Inspect relevant Anascummis source through paginated harness tools, cite paths and hashes, and reuse only needed modules in an independently runnable app.
Use a resident local Qwen 0.6B with bounded decisions and no external language-model API; run a no-network inference test after installing weights.
Enumerate and select camera and microphone, preserve settings, handle permission rejection and show a real preview.
Search current public sources for creator/community stories aligned with Atrioc, Ludwig and Jerma; retain search queries, URLs and retrieval dates.
Check recent SlopLive/PyroLive coverage and record uncertainty; do not claim absence of coverage or responses from search absence.
Investigate independent story candidates concurrently with scoped evidence; corroborate factual claims from read sources and distinguish allegation, opinion and confirmed fact.
Create coherent sourced scripts and show a teleprompter beside actual visual references and master audio controls.
Record real camera/microphone segments after a three-second countdown; preserve originals and detect semantic completion, with a manual override.
A long pause alone never ends recording. Test flubs, off-script speech, incomplete closing sentences and a completed ending.
Produce editable evidence-based cut suggestions from actual transcripts and audio timings; retain original takes and let the user reject cuts.
Render watchable real footage with tested transitions, graphics, inserts, overlays, source clips and licensed/user-supplied music/effects; no fabricated media.
Reorder and exclude whole story chunks; trims and visual/audio changes affect the final render.
Decode the exported video with FFmpeg; verify duration, audio/video streams, dimensions and ordering against timeline evidence.

Provide YouTube OAuth and explicit upload controls; verify request scopes, resumable upload, retries and failure handling with a test server. Disclose that a real account upload still requires user credentials and approval.
Publish timestamped QA progress and real screenshots while working; retry repairs within a visible budget and preserve failures.
Produce a reproducible Bun/Next/React source ZIP excluding secrets, personal recordings, node_modules and credentials; install/build/test in a clean workspace.

Produce a Windows executable and test launch, settings persistence, local Qwen inference and bundled resources on Windows. Document dependencies and first-run model downloads; never rename a ZIP to EXE or claim an untested launcher is verified.

leadPolicy: Research leads only. Verify chronology and original sources at execution time. Do not invent a current event or assert that no response exists.
